name: kamoca
description: Claude Code plugins from kamoca, grouped by domain (git, craft, docker).

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Atomic semantic commits with a body. A branch is required. Commits to main need an audited /git:main.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: ATDD workflow and refactor guided by principles (SOLID, KISS, YAGNI, DRY, Clean Code), with one skill for each principle.

plugins.name: docker
plugins.description: Docker environment for dev (hot reload) and prod (./deploy, lean image). Hooks enforce the rules. Tuning uses measurements.
